proxy_note: Proxy: maximum over the supplied months of monthly-mean daytime LST (MOD11C3, 0.05 deg). The Phase 1 feature is the maximum clear-sky daily LST in local summer at 1 km. Tolerance 15 degC = 5 degC (within-feature fine tolerance) + 9.5 to 9.7 degC (p95 of |gap_seed - gap_candidate|, where gap = 1 km daily extreme minus coarse monthly value), rounded up. Measured on six non-seed tiles (Sahara, Tibet, Atacama, Siberia, Greenland, East Antarctica; Jan+Jul 2025; docs/prefilter.md). Fixed before search; review with Ryan.
